title: Mask-denoising methods learn lower-semantic representations
description: The paper states that generative mask-denoising methods produce representations of a lower semantic level that underperform invariance-based methods in off-the-shelf evaluations like linear probing, requiring end-to-end fine-tuning to be effective.
canonical_description: mask-denoising generative methods produce lower-semantic representations requiring fine-tuning

evidence.quote: the resulting representations are typically of a lower semantic level and underperform invariance-based pretraining in off-the-shelf evaluations (e.g., linear-probing) and in transfer settings with limited supervision for semantic classification tasks
